summary: Testing of YAMA+ Custom Request System: Vehicle requests, Sofa orders, Reupholstery quotes, and Admin dashboard. All backend API tests pass (26/26). All frontend E2E tests pass (19/19).

vehicle_request_form.details: POST /api/custom-requests/vehicle creates vehicle search request with VEH-XXXXXXXX number. Form validates required fields (brand, full_name, phone). Customs status options (sous_douane/dedouane) working.

sofa_request_form.details: POST /api/custom-requests/sofa creates custom sofa order with SAL-XXXXXXXX number. Form validates required fields (sofa_type, full_name, phone). Options for armrests, headrests, storage working.

reupholstery_request_form.details: POST /api/custom-requests/reupholstery creates reupholstery quote with REH-XXXXXXXX number. Requires at least 1 photo. Service types (rehoussage, reparation, rembourrage, nettoyage) and urgency options working.

admin_custom_requests_dashboard.details: Admin can view all custom requests with stats cards showing totals for vehicle/sofa/reupholstery. Filter by type and status working. Search by request number, name, phone working.

admin_stats_endpoint.details: GET /api/custom-requests/admin/stats returns aggregated counts by type and status.

admin_update_status.details: PUT /api/custom-requests/admin/{request_number}/status updates request status, admin notes, and quote amount.

admin_propose_vehicle.details: POST /api/custom-requests/admin/{request_number}/propose-vehicle adds proposed vehicle to vehicle requests only.

track_request.details: GET /api/custom-requests/track/{request_number} returns public tracking info for any request type.

vehicle_customs_status_display.details: ProductPage shows customs status badge (sous_douane/dedouane) for automobile products with vehicle_specs.customs_status. data-testid='vehicle-customs-status' added.

seed_data_creation: Test data created during test runs with TEST_ prefix for identification
context_for_next_testing_agent: All custom request features tested and working. Backend API at /api/custom-requests/ handles vehicle, sofa, and reupholstery requests. Admin dashboard at /admin/custom-requests shows stats and allows filtering/searching. All forms have data-testids for E2E testing. Vehicle customs status display on ProductPage has data-testid='vehicle-customs-status'.
